content.text:
Implemented the requested BIGThreeAstrology improvements directly in the current project and kept it lightweight (plain HTML/CSS/JS).

### What I changed

- Updated CTA text from `Calculate My Big 3` to `Get My Sun, Moon & Rising`.
- Added required `Your Name` input to all calculator forms:
  - `index.html`
  - `rising-sign-calculator.html`
  - `moon-sign-calculator.html`
  - `sun-sign-calculator.html`
- Kept birth time prominent and explicitly required with clearer label `Birth Time (Required)`.
- Refocused homepage around the main calculator experience:
  - cleaner above-the-fold hierarchy
  - reduced distractions
  - stronger card structure
  - better grouped form fields with fieldset/legend
- Improved UX polish:
  - cleaner spacing/typography
  - stronger card emphasis for calculator area
  - improved label clarity and input focus styles
  - smoother results reveal animation (opacity/slide/max-height transition)
- Preserved fast implementation:
  - no framework added
  - only static HTML/CSS/JS edits
- Integrated keyword mapping naturally in title/meta/headings/support text using:
  - `sun moon rising sign calculator free`
  - `sun moon rising calculator`
- Kept multipage structure and internal links intact.

### Files changed

- `index.html`
- `styles.css`
- `app.js`
- `rising-sign-calculator.html`
- `moon-sign-calculator.html`
- `sun-sign-calculator.html`

### End-to-end behavior check

- Verified calculator pages still include `data-calc-root` and required fields.
- Updated JS validation to include name + existing birth details.
- Confirmed submit flow still computes and reveals dynamic `Sun/Moon/Rising` results via `app.js`.

### Follow-up recommendations

- Current sign logic is deterministic placeholder hashing; for astrology-accurate output, next step is replacing `calc()` in `app.js` with real ephemeris-based calculations.
- Add a tiny FAQ block on homepage for a couple of long-tail queries (still lightweight) if you want deeper SEO coverage.
